room.decisions.title: Decision register
room.decisions.text: What the war room decided, each with a D-number, an owner, a target date and time, optional approvers and what it applies to. Responders and leads propose decisions, record a call already made as approved, or register a /decision chat message; the outcome and the implementation show in the stream. Guests read the register.

items.name: Pending
items.text: Proposed and waiting for its approvers, or for a lead or the owner when it has none.

items.name: Approved
items.text: Every approver approved (without approvers, a lead or the owner did). Can be marked implemented, superseded, or cited by an asset flag or a vulnerability finding.

items.name: Superseded
items.text: A later decision that replaces it was approved.

decision.approvers.title: Approvers
decision.approvers.text: Room members who must approve the decision: it is approved once every one of them approves, and rejected as soon as one rejects. With no approver, a lead or the owner approves or rejects it. Approvers are fixed once the decision is decided.

decision.status.title: Status when proposing
decision.status.text: Pending puts the decision to its approvers - or, when it has none, to a lead or its owner. Approved records a call already made: it is offered only without approvers, and only a lead or the decision's owner can record it.

decision.applies_to.title: Applies to
decision.applies_to.text: The whole war room, or chosen cases and assets of the attached cases. An asset flag that requires a decision, or a vulnerability finding, can cite an approved decision that applies to the room, to the asset's case or to the asset. A case you cannot open shows as restricted.

decision.target.title: Target
decision.target.text: When the decision should be carried out (UTC). An open decision - proposed, or approved and not implemented - past its target shows as overdue and on the Board.

decision.implementation.title: Implementation
decision.implementation.text: A lead or the owner marks an approved decision implemented (and can reopen it). An implemented decision is no longer open.

room.board.title: Board
room.board.text: The war room at a glance: a row of indicator tiles (compromised assets, open decisions, exceptions, open tasks, flags, open vulnerabilities and more), then panels: one card per attached case, open decisions, what needs attention and open tasks. Needs attention lists what nobody has triaged yet. Figures cover the attached cases you can open and refresh every minute; a tile opens the matching tab, filtered. A lead sets the widgets for everyone (Edit board); anyone can hide, reorder or move them just for themselves (Customize, kept in this browser).

room.scope.title: Scope
room.scope.text: Every asset of the cases attached to this war room that you can open: type, IP, customer, compromise and analysis status, flags, linked IOCs and open vulnerability findings. Filter by case, customer, flag, compromise, findings or a vulnerability identifier, or search by name, IP, domain or tags; group by case or by vulnerability. The Board's tiles and flag legend open this tab already filtered. Cases you cannot open are only counted. Guests do not get this tab.

items.name: Select assets
items.text: Responders and leads of an open room tick assets to set or remove flags, set the compromise or analysis status, or push them to other attached cases, all at once. Each asset needs full access to its case: the others are reported as refused and left unchanged.

items.name: Push to cases
items.text: Copies an asset (name, type, description, IP, domain, tags, compromise and analysis status) into other attached cases you can change. The flags are not copied; a case that already holds the asset is skipped.

items.name: Copy
items.text: Copies a group's assets as a table (pick the columns) to paste into a sheet or a note, or downloads them as CSV.

items.name: Flag board
items.text: One column per flag. Drag an asset's card onto a flag to set it; a flag that needs a reason or a decision asks for it first.

room.scope_iocs.title: Scope IOCs
room.scope_iocs.text: Every IOC of the attached cases you can open, deduplicated: one row per indicator (same type, same value once defanged spellings and letter case are set aside), one column per case. A tick means the case holds it; a dashed cell is a case missing it, and clicking it copies the IOC there (value, type, TLP, description and tags). A row's TLP is the most restrictive of its cases'. Select rows to push several at once.

room.scope_customers.title: Scope customers
room.scope_customers.text: The scope summed per customer of the attached cases you can open: its cases, assets, compromised assets, assets with a done flag, IOCs (distinct per case, summed) and open vulnerability findings. The button shows that customer's assets.

room.scope_staging.title: Staging
room.scope_staging.text: Assets and IOCs typed into the war room before they land in a case (Add asset or Add IOC with Stage for later), kept with the cases they are meant for. Push creates one in the selected cases through each case's own path; the row goes once every target case holds it. Discard drops one that was never pushed. Responders and leads of an open room change the inbox; every member reads it.

room.scope_registry.title: Attached from the Assets Manager
room.scope_registry.text: Assets of the customer registry put in this room's scope, with or without one of its cases. You see the ones of customers you have access to, and a count of the others. Push copies one into attached cases as a case asset (name, type, compromise status, and the IP, domain, tags and description of its latest sighting), where flags and statuses apply. Detach removes it from the room; it stays in the Assets Manager.

room.scope_export.title: Export the scope's IOCs
room.scope_export.text: Every IOC you can see in the attached cases, deduplicated, as a file.

items.name: Blocklist (.txt)
items.text: One value per line. TLP:RED IOCs are left out unless Include TLP:RED is ticked; an IOC with no TLP goes out.

items.name: CSV
items.text: Value, type, TLP, description, tags, cases and customers. TLP:RED is left out unless Include TLP:RED is ticked.

items.name: STIX 2.1
items.text: TLP:GREEN and TLP:CLEAR only, whatever is ticked: an IOC with no TLP or a stricter one is not shareable. How many were left out is shown after the download.
